newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Avgold says 3 dead, 16 missing at Harties.
newsitem.headline: Avgold says 3 dead, 16 missing at Harties.

text.p: South African gold mining firm Avgold Ltd said on Monday that three employees had been killed and 16 were missing after a seismic event at its Hartebeestfontein mine.
The firm said in a statement that a large seismic event had occurred at the mine's No 4 A shaft area at a depth below surface of about 2,170 metres, causing severe damage to underground excavations.
Avgold said that another employee was in intensive care and that an additional 29 had been admitted to hospital.
It said that rescue efforts were continuing and that further statements would be issued as necessary.
